 Hockey Inside Out 
 Nilan, Skrudland reminisce about Canadiens’ first outdoor game in frigid Edmonton 
 On this Hockey Inside/Out Show bonus episode, former Habs share frosty bench memories about 2003 Heritage Classic. 
 By 
 Montreal Gazette 
 October 25, 2026 at 6:00 a.m. 
 The Canadiens will play the Jets on Sunday in an outdoor Heritage Classic game at Winnipeg’s Princess Auto Stadium (7 p.m., SN, TVA Sports). 
 On this Hockey Inside/Out Show bonus episode, former teammates and 1986 Stanley Cup champions Chris Nilan and Brian Skrudland share their memories of playing in outdoor games with the Canadiens’ alumni team, including at the first Heritage Classic in Edmonton in 2003 in freezing conditions. Nilan tells the story about why he threw up on the bench during that alumni game.
 Wayne Gretzky of the Edmonton Oilers with the Canadiens after the Heritage Classic Megastars Game on Nov. 22, 2003, at Commonwealth Stadium in Edmonton. Jeff Vinnick / Getty Images 
 The panel also discusses whether there are now too many outdoor games in the NHL.
